sourceReview: Punjab PULSE GIS / Punjab Land Records Authority first-party public map service

routes.outcome: Loaded public viewer HTML; followed its JavaScript configuration to the ArcGIS REST service and anonymous public token endpoint.
Initially returned ArcGIS 499 Token Required; the viewer's public /api/gis/token route returned a short-lived map-service token, then the service root and Gujrat layer metadata loaded.

Loaded Gujrat Feature Layer schema: polygon geometry, source WKID 102100, fields include OBJECTID, Khasra_ID, Mouza and other source fields. Only OBJECTID and Khasra_ID were requested from feature queries.
Anonymous point-intersection request at [32.8026456496482,73.8740986220131] in EPSG:4326 returned one feature, OBJECTID 8382212, with geometry suppressed.

Anonymous bounded envelope around the exact point returned three polygon features; a follow-up safe-ID query returned full geometry for OBJECTIDs 8382212, 8171543, and 8171544, reprojected to EPSG:4326 and retained in kharian-sample.geojson.
Login/CAPTCHA wall observed; no login attempted and no registry document/owner fields requested.

scope.interpretation: The exact point intersects a mapped cadastral polygon. The envelope is a bounded sample, not a citywide completeness test; absence outside the envelope or in other layers would not prove absence.

fieldAllowlist.retained: GeoJSON properties contain exactly one canonical identity: id=OBJECTID:<value>

identity.reason: ArcGIS OID is the service's native stable feature identity; Khasra_ID was observed as a source field but is not retained in feature properties.

uncertainty: PULSE disclaimer says digital map lines are indicative and not legal boundaries.
The public map is a provincial cadastral layer and does not establish every legal parcel or citywide coverage boundary.
The PLRA/e-registration route requires login/CAPTCHA and was not used.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
completion: complete after recording all executed attempts; no credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, commits, pushes, deployments, or external contacts used.
